notes: One Diag workflow: safe checks, visible progress, collection and a matching downloadable snapshot. Close/rejoin, stop/partial evidence and completed reports survive without attaching unrelated Test runs. Busy work collects evidence and discloses skipped checks. Optional local JSON, real acceptance-schema and consented cloud probes use fixed synthetic inputs, never project content or generated-code execution. Latest planning attempts, rejected drafts and timeouts are shown before a proposal exists. New browser feature-by-feature plans use portable assertion wire v2, compiled losslessly to the unchanged approval contract. Precise assertion paths and value validity replace generic structure errors; correction packets use current feature context. Existing saved v1 plans/checkpoints, approved checks, routes, consent and output floors remain intact. No dependency, reviewer loop or live model/GPU performance claim.
